purpose: Convert the approved argument into viewer-attention, camera, proof and fallback decisions.
hard_gates: Every beat needs one primary attention target, truth role, safe fallback and exact lineage.
A story of more than one beat must open a question at or after the hook and answer it in a later beat.
soft_gates: Every visual should strengthen comprehension, emotion, proof or narrative momentum.

failure.fallback: Prefer presenter-primary conservative framing and surface the missing visual proof for review.

regression_cases: Dense proof cannot compete with captions and Krish's face at the same moment.
A new signature device requires styleframe and animatic review.
A multi-beat plan with no open question is rejected.
A beat may only answer a question opened by an earlier beat.
A single-beat plan is exempt: it has no story after the hook.
